text.text: Cisco C220 M4 Rack Server

graphic.text: Cisco C220 M4 Rack Server

text.text: The enterprise-class Cisco UCS C220 M4 server extends the capabilities of the Cisco UCS portfolio in a 1RU form factor. It incorporates the Intel ® Xeon ® processor E5-2600 v3 product family, next-generation DDR4 memory, and 12-Gbps SAS throughput, delivering significant performance and efficiency gains.
